_comment: Fallback and policy data for `zmig plan` hop suggestions. LTS facts are read from Zephyr's own docs first (doc/releases/index.rst at the target ref, and each release's notes); the 'lts' list here is used only for releases those don't state, and findings say which source was used. 'boundaries' (contract-breaking releases) has no machine-readable source in Zephyr and is maintained here. Override the whole file with --release-data or $ZMIG_RELEASE_DATA.

3.7.title: Hardware Model v2
3.7.detail: Board names gain SoC/variant qualifiers (e.g. native_sim_64 -> native_sim/native/64); boards/deprecated.cmake maps old names, and board directories and Kconfig were restructured.
